workflow: We applied a quantitative proteomics approach to establish an interactome of SEPT9 in human fibroblast cells.
The TAP-SEPT9 expressing cell lines were labeled with heavy amino acids by cultivating them in L-13C615N4 Arginine and 3C615N2 L-Lysine containing medium (SILAC).
Samples were measured using an LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro system
Database search was performed using MaxQuant Vers. 1.5.2.8
differential: For each identified protein we calculated a “heavy over light” (H/L) ratio
The LOG2(H/L) reflects the enrichment of a protein in the TAP-SEPT9 purification (H) in comparison to the GFP-SEPT9 purification (L).
Significance B was calculated using Perseus 1.5.0.15
search_parameters: Carbamidomethylated cysteine was considered as a fixed modification along with oxidation (M), and acetylated protein N-termini as variable modifications.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment uses a 'mixing after purification' (MAP) approach for SILAC quantification, comparing TAP-SEPT9 (Heavy) against GFP-SEPT9 (Light) as a control.
